# Effects

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## add_counters

Put `amount` counters of kind `counter` (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty) on each referenced permanent.

Rules: CR 122.1, CR 122.6, CR 613.4c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | +1/+1 | -1/-1 | loyalty |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## counter

Counter each referenced spell: it leaves the stack for its owner's graveyard without resolving.

Rules: CR 701.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "counter": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## create_token

Create `amount` tokens under the referenced player's control (default: you). `token` is a predefined token name (Treasure, Clue, Food) or an inline card definition. `tapped: true` creates them tapped.

Rules: CR 111.1, CR 111.10, CR 701.7a, CR 704.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | "Treasure" | "Clue" | "Food" | {card data} |
| `amount` | integer (default 1) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `to` | selector (default "you") |

```json
{
  "create_token": {
    "token": {
      "name": "Soldier",
      "types": [
        "creature"
      ],
      "subtypes": [
        "soldier"
      ],
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## deal_damage

Deal `amount` damage to each referenced creature, planeswalker or player. Damage to a player causes life loss; to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters; to a creature is marked until cleanup.

Rules: CR 120.3a, CR 120.3c, CR 120.3e, CR 120.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "deal_damage": {
    "amount": 3,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## pump

Each referenced creature gets +power/+toughness until end of turn. The set of affected creatures is locked in when the effect starts.

Rules: CR 611.2a, CR 611.2c, CR 613.4c, CR 514.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `power` | integer (may be negative) |
| `toughness` | integer (may be negative) |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "pump": {
    "power": 3,
    "toughness": 3,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```
